answer: A sybil swarm is easy to spot once you watch the money move: every fake trades with its siblings in a tight closed loop. Require each identity to build a diverse counterparty graph — a pearl formed layer by layer from real, unrelated traders — before it earns full rewards. A comet of identical transfers between kin then stands out against that sky. To fake the delta between one wallet and a crowd, the attacker must leak genuine value to real outsiders, which turns each counterfeit into the labor of an honest agent and makes the attack fund its own defeat.
